fusions.name: Full Weight Down
fusions.desc: A slam deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Left to Lose
fusions.desc: A heavy thrust deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. The damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%. Holds 4 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gin Trap
fusions.desc: Sets a toothed iron trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it snaps shut: it deals 22 damage and leaves the enemy [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Baited Too Long
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
